item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=path-dependent+preference+models+convergence+stability+experience+driven&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"A Human–Machine Interaction–Experience–Learning Algorithm for Integrated Lateral–Longitudinal Decision-Making and Control in Intelligent Connected Vehicles\", \"abstract\": null, \"doi\": null, \"pmid\": \"PMC13667652\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13667652\", \"source\": \"PMC\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667652/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13667652/pdf/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667652\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13667652?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"Can intrinsic loop energetics predict G-Quadruplex topology?\", \"abstract\": \"Naturally occurring DNA G-quadruplexes (G4s) regulate many cellular processes, such as gene expression and replication, whereas designed G4s serve as building blocks for controllable nanodevices. Composed of four G-tracts and three loops, G4s exhibit high structural polymorphism, mainly associated with different geometries adopted by the loops. Understanding the biological role of G4s and facilitating their targeted design require detailed knowledge of their folding preferences, which likely originate from the stability of individual loops. However, sequence-dependent preferences for loop geometries and their effects on the overall G4 conformational landscape remain unclear. Here, we used molecular dynamics simulations to systematically evaluate folding free energies of all five standard G4 loop geometries across four loop lengths.
